personality_one_liner: An authoritative, high-density, no-nonsense enterprise tool focused on operational clarity, structural grids, and uncompromised data visibility.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids, hard alignment, and visible spacing systems. Structural margins are absolute. Avoid soft padding; prefer edge-to-edge separators.

do's: Use solid surface or surfaceSecondary backgrounds.
Rely on thick borders and dividers for hierarchy instead of elevation or blur.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure gateway for reps and managers via Google Workspace.

states.loading: Solid charcoal screen with a brutalist mono-font loading percentage.
states.error: Hard red error banner at the top with a sharp white retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed architectural background photo with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim. At the bottom 30%, a massive 'Space Grotesk' app title and a full-width sharp-cornered Google Sign-in button.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for the rep/manager showing KPIs (Demands vs Placement, Pipeline, Targets, Outstanding).

states.empty: Sharp illustration with 'No data for today' in Space Grotesk.
states.error: Exposed error state block with mono-font error code and retry CTA.

screens.layout: Grid-based modular dashboard. Top: Oversized JetBrains Mono metric counters with 2pt borders separating them. Middle: Bar chart using stark monochrome + success green for placements. Bottom: Outstanding payments summary block with a hard red accent.

screens.name: Pipeline
screens.purpose: Track new acquisitions through stages (Lead -> Contacted -> Demo -> Negotiation -> Won).
screens.layout: Vertical stage-grouped list (mobile-friendly Kanban alternative). Sticky stage headers with heavy bottom borders. Cards have 1pt borders, no shadows, displaying deal values in JetBrains Mono. Swipe left/right on cards to advance/revert stages.

screens.name: Customers
screens.layout: Edge-to-edge list. Each row separated by a 1pt divider. Real logos (via transparent PNGs) on the left, customer name in Geist bold, total revenue in JetBrains Mono on the right.

screens.name: Payments
screens.layout: High-density data table format. Left column: Client name. Right column: Amount (Mono). Overdue rows have a 2pt Signal Red left border. 'Mark Reminder Sent' is a sharp, flat icon button in the row.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User settings, logout, and manager team-view toggle.
screens.layout: Brutalist settings list. Large avatar/initials at top. Hard toggles (color flip, no soft shadows). 'Manager View' toggle prominently framed in a 2pt bordered box.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 5 Brutalist Mobile personality: use 0px border radius (sharp corners), no shadows, no glassmorphism, and 1pt/2pt solid borders for structural framing.
Data components (deal amounts, payment values, KPI numbers, dates) MUST use the 'JetBrains Mono' font for a technical, operational feel.
Do NOT use any blues or purples. Use #111827 (Charcoal) for primary actions, #059669 (Emerald) for target achievements/wins, and #DC2626 (Signal Red) specifically for overdue payments and errors.

The Pipeline screen should use a vertical list grouped by stage with sticky headers (mobile-adapted Kanban) rather than a horizontally scrolling web-like Kanban board. Add swipe gestures to move items between stages.
For the Customers list, assume we will load actual customer logo PNGs. Use square, sharp-edged image containers. Use initials with a solid background as a fallback only if the image fails.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, toggles, tabs) use color-flip states instead of scale animations or soft opacity fades.
The Dashboard should feel like a dense, high-contrast command center. Use 2pt thick borders (`borderStrong`) to segment major KPI blocks.
